
        private static ActionPlayerProductAssetReceipt[] CollectProductionAssets(ActionPlayerProductProfile profile, ActionPresentationManifest manifest, ActionProductionPresentation presentation)
        {
            var receipts = new List<ActionPlayerProductAssetReceipt>();
            var approvalIds = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            var approvalAuthorityIds = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            var approvalNames = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            var approvedAts = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            var player = CollectAsset("player:rhea-venn", manifest.player.bodyPrefab, presentation.PlayerPrefab, profile);
            receipts.Add(player);
            foreach (var binding in manifest.enemies)
            {
                var runtime = presentation.EnemyPrefabs.SingleOrDefault(value => value != null && value.kit == binding.kit);
                receipts.Add(CollectAsset("enemy:" + binding.kit, binding.bodyPrefab, runtime == null ? null : runtime.prefab, profile));
            }
            receipts.Add(CollectAsset("arena:pump-seven", manifest.arena.recipe, AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>(manifest.arena.recipe), profile));
            foreach (var receipt in receipts)
            {
                if (!receipt.approved) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player product contains an unapproved production asset: " + receipt.assetId);
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(receipt.approvalId) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(receipt.approvalAuthorityId) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(receipt.approvalName) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(receipt.approvalAttestation) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(receipt.approvedAt)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player product asset lacks complete named approval custody: " + receipt.assetId);
                approvalIds.Add(receipt.approvalId);
                approvalAuthorityIds.Add(receipt.approvalAuthorityId);
                approvalNames.Add(receipt.approvalName);
                approvedAts.Add(receipt.approvedAt);
                if (receipt.generatedPrimitive) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player product contains a generated primitive: " + receipt.assetId);
                if (receipt.activePhysicsAuthority) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player product contains active Unity combat physics authority: " + receipt.assetId);
                if (profile.presentation.assetProvenanceRequired && string.IsNullOrEmpty(receipt.sourceSha256)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player product asset lacks imported-source provenance: " + receipt.assetId);
            }
            if (approvalIds.Count != 1 || approvalAuthorityIds.Count != 1 || approvalNames.Count != 1 || approvedAts.Count != 1) throw new InvalidOperationException("Player product assets do not share one exact named representation approval.");
            return receipts.ToArray();
        }

        private static ActionPlayerProductAssetReceipt CollectAsset(string assetId, string expectedPath, GameObject prefab, ActionPlayerProductProfile profile)
        {
            if (prefab == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Production prefab is absent: " + expectedPath);
            var path = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(prefab).Replace('\\', '/');
            if (path != expectedPath.Replace('\\', '/')) throw new InvalidOperationException("Serialized prefab differs from the authored presentation path: " + assetId);
            var marker = prefab.GetComponent<ActionProductionAssetMarker>();
            if (marker == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Production prefab lacks an ActionProductionAssetMarker: " + assetId);
            marker.RequireProductionApproved();
            if (marker.AssetId != assetId) throw new InvalidOperationException("Production asset id differs from the authored player product: " + assetId);
            var generatedPrimitive = path.Contains("/Generated/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || path.Contains("/Primitive", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            var activePhysics = HasActivePhysics(prefab);
            if (assetId == "arena:pump-seven") activePhysics = false; // Static camera collision is presentation-only and separately measured.
            return new ActionPlayerProductAssetReceipt
            {
                assetId = assetId,
                prefabPath = path,
                prefabSha256 = Sha256File(ToProjectFile(path)),
                sourcePath = marker.VisualSourcePath,
                sourceSha256 = marker.VisualSourceSha256,
                approved = marker.ProductionApproved,
                approvalId = marker.ApprovalId,
                approvalAuthorityId = marker.ApprovalAuthorityId,
                approvalName = marker.ApprovalName,
                approvalAttestation = marker.ApprovalAttestation,
                approvedAt = marker.ApprovedAt,
                generatedPrimitive = generatedPrimitive,
                activePhysicsAuthority = activePhysics,
            };
        }

        private static bool HasActivePhysics(GameObject prefab)
        {
            if (prefab.GetComponentsInChildren<Rigidbody>(true).Any(body => body != null && !body.isKinematic)) return true;
            return prefab.GetComponentsInChildren<Collider>(true).Any(collider => collider != null && collider.enabled);
        }

        private static int CountArenaCollisionSurfaces(string assetPath)
        {
            var arena = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>(assetPath);
            if (arena == null) return 0;
            return arena.GetComponentsInChildren<Collider>(true).Count(collider => collider != null && collider.enabled && collider.gameObject.isStatic);
        }

        private static T FindSingle<T>() where T : UnityEngine.Object
        {
            var values = UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<T>(true);
            if (values.Length != 1) throw new InvalidOperationException("Serialized player scene must contain exactly one " + typeof(T).Name + "; found " + values.Length + ".");
            return values[0];
        }

        private static void WriteReceipt(string path, ActionPlayerProductReceipt receipt)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path) ?? ".");
            File.WriteAllText(path, JsonUtility.ToJson(receipt, true));
        }

        private static string GetRequiredArgument(string name)
        {
            var value = GetOptionalArgument(name);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Missing required argument " + name + ".");
            return value;
        }

        private static string GetOptionalArgument(string name)
        {
            var args = Environment.GetCommandLineArgs();
            for (var i = 0; i < args.Length - 1; i++) if (args[i] == name) return args[i + 1];
            return null;
        }

        private static string NormalizeAssetPath(string value)
        {
            var normalized = (value ?? string.Empty).Replace('\\', '/');
            if (!normalized.StartsWith("Assets/", StringComparison.Ordinal)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Expected project asset path, got " + value);
            return normalized;
        }

        private static string ToProjectFile(string assetPath)
        {
            var normalized = NormalizeAssetPath(assetPath);
            return Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Application.dataPath, "..", normalized.Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar)));
        }

        private static void RequireHexCommit(string value, string label)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) || value.Length != 40 || value.Any(character => !Uri.IsHexDigit(character))) throw new InvalidOperationException(label + " must be a 40-character hexadecimal commit.");
        }

        private static string Sha256File(string path)
        {
            using (var stream = File.OpenRead(path))
            using (var sha = SHA256.Create()) return ToHex(sha.ComputeHash(stream));
        }

        private static string Sha256String(string value)
        {
            using (var sha = SHA256.Create()) return ToHex(sha.ComputeHash(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(value ?? string.Empty)));
        }

        private static string ToHex(byte[] value)
        {
            var characters = new char[value.Length * 2];
            var index = 0;
            foreach (var item in value)
            {
                characters[index++] = GetHex(item >> 4);
                characters[index++] = GetHex(item & 15);
            }
            return new string(characters);
        }

        private static char GetHex(int value) => (char)(value < 10 ? '0' + value : 'a' + value - 10);
    }
}
